I just want to be healthy, not feel pressured into losing weight when I’m already at a healthy one. And, in the end, I don’t particularly care too much, I just deleted the app again, but what about the teenagers using this app? (There is a specific option when you log in to state you are under 18.) It’s one thing for the option to be there, in fact, I think it’s great for those who need or want it, but the way that this is constantly shoved down your throat is ridiculous.
